//: Typechecks server/ AND prisma/. The root tsconfig.json can only cover server/ because its rootDir is ./server — adding prisma/ there would break the dist/ layout. prisma/seed.ts runs via tsx and would otherwise never be typechecked, so a stale enum reference in it only surfaces at runtime. Run: node node_modules/typescript/bin/tsc --project tsconfig.check.json
